title: Μαγειρική
description: Ten short stories and texts about cooking and food in Greece: a village women's sweet-making group, a student's dirty fridge, a cooking contest, light meals after an operation, a fish taverna on the rocks, a theatre group's dinner, a report on home cooking, lunch for a meeting of mayors, the New Year cake and home-baked bread.

lessons.title: Τα γλυκά του χωριού
lessons.summary: Mrs Katerina starts a women's group that makes sweets in her hillside village, and an old van helps them sell them in town.

lessons.title: Το ψυγείο του Νίκου
lessons.summary: Student Nikos hears that his mother is coming and spends an evening cleaning out his dirty fridge.

lessons.title: Ο διαγωνισμός της ακαδημίας
lessons.summary: Myrto, a student at a cooking academy, feels stressed at the yearly contest but wins with her grandmother's recipe.

lessons.title: Το φαγητό του παππού
lessons.summary: After grandfather Thanasis has an operation, his granddaughter cooks the light meals the doctor allows.

lessons.title: Το εστιατόριο στους βράχους
lessons.summary: Fisherman Stratos runs a small fish restaurant on the rocks of an island, and a Canadian couple calls it a treasure.

lessons.title: Το δείπνο της θεατρικής ομάδας
lessons.summary: After the annual play, actor Lefteris cooks dinner for his theatre group, cuts his finger and gets a pink sweet from a little girl.

lessons.title: Μαγειρεύουμε ακόμα στο σπίτι;
lessons.summary: A short report: researchers say Greek families cook less at home, and a town programme gives them a reason to cook again.

lessons.title: Το γεύμα της συνόδου
lessons.summary: Eleni's small company gets an urgent order to cook lunch for a meeting of mayors next to a monument in Nafplio.

lessons.title: Το νόμισμα της Πρωτοχρονιάς
lessons.summary: On New Year's Eve the family cuts the New Year cake, little Petros does the sums for the pieces, and the hidden coin goes to grandma.

lessons.title: Το ψωμί της Αλεξάνδρας
lessons.summary: After her divorce, court clerk Alexandra looks for something new, repairs her grandmother's old village oven and learns to bake bread by hand.
